record.label: Packed-D4 lifetime gate and residual reclassification
record.summary: The target-free static gate proves changing-rank byte/meter parity and a lifetime-layout saving of 1,322,696,704 persistent scratch bytes plus 33,554,432 cold binding FLOPs. The frozen no-retry five-component [35,279,35] gate then stopped on its first unchanged-D4 parent call: residual 0.5711876060813665 seconds was not strictly below 0.4, while FLOPs, call count, RSS, and output were otherwise admissible. The packed candidate made zero calls. A static residual-sync audit found the same parent arithmetic and 15,416-call inventory had previously measured 0.3257444277405739 seconds, so the parent-over-cap run is non-discriminating: it closes this gate without rejecting packed-D4 runtime, and it does not certify candidate runtime or full-component parity. D4 #328622 remains the scored bank.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured for this immutable instrumented full-gate spelling with no retry and no candidate call. Preserve the static lifetime-memory and cold-FLOP proof, but claim no packed runtime, production replacement, accuracy result, package, or submission. Only a materially new sync-free lean matched parent/candidate/parent A/B/A successor may revisit runtime, and both unchanged-parent calls must first be strictly below 0.4 seconds.
